interface.longDescription: Build Vietnamese Zodiac sticker-story videos with evidence-bounded Direct or Conversational delivery, micro-scenes and narrator reactions, semantic reusable assets, coordinated interaction choreography, and data-only zodiac-job@3 packages pinned to Zodiac Studio runtime.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use skills/zodiac-video-pipeline/SKILL.md. Before writing, choose story shape separately from delivery_mode (direct|conversational) using references/narrative-modes.md. Conversational is a delivery layer, not a mandatory section: topic/sign must appear early, riff is short, contradiction must be evidence-bounded, and relational beats must compile into Interaction Choreography. Write .authoring/narrative-plan.json and validate narration with validate-narrative.mjs; never ship .authoring/**. Preserve approved insight/evidence. Keep canonical asset-library-v3 v3.4 and runtime zodiac-remotion@1.15.0 hash 4d52e6ca766649546482a5cdfbf879f4f19c4d3c41c07c7743cccec1a7100ffa. Do not add reusable state assets or make zodiac-job@3 heavier.
